title: Grateful Dead Partners with Taylor Stitch for a New Menswear Collection: Here’s How to Shop Online
summary: The limited-edition line features Grateful Dead Oxford shirts, hats, button and patch sets, t-shirts and other items — prices start at $45.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

For more than 60 years, Grateful Dead has been one of the most celebrated bands in music history. The Northern California rock band has a long tradition of engaging with their fans in creative ways. Case in point: Grateful Dead’s partnership with San Francisco-based menswear company Taylor Stitch. The new menswear line shows off the band’s affinity for vintage-inspired workwear, casual styles and detailed accessories.

With prices starting at $45, the Grateful Dead x Taylor Stitch collection is inspired by The Dead’s early touring years as a real working band. In the collection, you’ll find a rugged denim jacket, a worn Oxford shirt, a number of t-shirts, button and patch sets, a selection of ball caps and other items. The line is available online and in stores, dropping on Wednesday (June 10) at 12 p.m. ET/9 a.m. PT.

Shop Grateful Dead x Taylor Stitch

“Grateful Dead have always felt bigger than a band — they represented a way of life rooted in creativity, community, and an independent spirit that still defines the region today,” says Luke McAlpine, head of brand at Taylor Stitch, in a press release. “This collaboration really channels the shared DNA between the two of us — a reverence for timeless style, lived-in utility, and the distinctly classic energy of Northern California.”
